source_title: Got My First Paying Customer 2 Days After Launch Wasnt Where I Expected D905B39341

snippets.snippet_text: "On Wednesday morning, while brewing coffee, an alert pops up - Payhip notifies me. A customer signed up for the monthly package costing forty-nine bucks. I honestly believed it was junk mail or some trial charge I'd overlooked. Looked into it again - twice more - to be sure. Nope. Actual buyer. Seems they arrived via SaaSHub, judging by the ref link - though truthfully, I can't say for certain; Payhip's logs aren't that clear."

intake_notes: Indie Hackers post (December 11, 2025). Seller got first Payhip customer 2 days after launch via SaaSHub referral; $49/month subscription; Payhip analytics could not confirm referral source.
possible_subjects: Payhip time-to-first-sale: 2 days after launch via SaaSHub referral
